description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline IPC component in the Rialto media framework. It tests the forwarding of media data events, including handling of shared memory info, session validation, and the 'haveData' IPC call, using Google Test framework with mock objects.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineIpcDataTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the MediaPipeline IPC data handling, including setup and teardown of IPC components and shared memory info initialization.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates IPC, and sets up shared memory info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys IPC.

methods.name: initShmInfo
methods.description: Initializes the shared memory info structure with predefined values.

methods.name: createNeedDataEvent
methods.description: Creates a NeedMediaDataEvent with optional shared memory info.
